outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: Introduction to Efficient Large Language Model Finetuning
outline.description: This chapter establishes the motivation for QLoRA by contrasting traditional finetuning constraints with the demands of modern Large Language Models (LLMs). It defines the central challenge: balancing massive model capacity with limited hardware resources.
subtopics: The prohibitive cost of full-parameter finetuning (e.g., >780GB VRAM for 65B models)
Overview of quantization limits in training versus inference
Introduction to QLoRA: Achieving 16-bit performance on a single 48GB GPU

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2: Foundational Concepts: Quantization and LoRA
outline.description: Before diving into QLoRA specifics, this chapter reviews the prerequisite technologies upon which it is built, ensuring readers understand the mechanics of block-wise quantization and Low-Rank Adaptation.
subtopics: Mechanism of Block-wise k-bit Quantization and handling outliers
The mathematical formulation of Layer-Wise Relevance Propagation in quantized networks
Deep dive into Low-rank Adapters (LoRA): Factorized projections and gradient flow
Analyzing Memory Footprint: Comparing parameter storage vs. activation gradients

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 3: Core Innovations of the QLoRA Architecture
outline.description: A technical dissection of the three primary architectural innovations that enable QLoRA's efficiency without compromising fidelity. This covers data types, compression tricks, and optimization management.
subtopics: NormalFloat (NF4) Data Type: Information-theoretic optimality for Gaussian distributions
Constructing an asymmetric data type for perfect zero representation
Double Quantization: Reducing overhead by compressing quantization constants themselves
Calculating memory savings per parameter via Double Quantization logic
Paged Optimizers: Managing peak memory usage via CPU/GPU unified memory swapping

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 4: The Mechanics Backpropagating Through Quantized Weights
outline.description: This chapter details the specific algorithmic pipeline of QLoRA, explaining how gradients traverse a frozen, low-precision backbone to update high-precision adapters.
subtopics: Forward Pass workflow: Storage format (NF4) vs. Computation format (BFloat16)

outline.headline: New AI Method Allows Single GPU Finetuning
